headline: Lilly Lifts 2026 Outlook as Foundayo Pill Adds $184M in Q3
summary: Q3 revenue grew 39% to $24.4B, with Mounjaro at $10.7B and Zepbound at $5.35B. Lilly raised its full-year revenue guidance to $91–92B.

headline: HHS Will Let Pharmacies Compound Six Peptides, Including BPC-157
summary: An interim HHS policy uses enforcement discretion to cover compounding of the six peptides an FDA panel backed in July. The FDA is still weighing a final decision.

headline: Retatrutide Beats Ozempic Head-to-Head in Type 2 Diabetes
summary: In the 80-week TRANSCEND-T2D-2 trial, retatrutide cut A1C by 2.2 points versus 1.8 for semaglutide 2 mg. Weight loss reached 20.9%, against 9.4% on semaglutide.

headline: CagriSema Shows 25% Average Weight Loss in Women
summary: A post-hoc REDEFINE 1 analysis found about 25% weight loss in women at 68 weeks, assuming they stayed on treatment. Novo expects to launch CagriSema early next year.

headline: Amylin Emerges as the Next Obesity Battleground for Lilly and Novo
summary: Eloralintide plus tirzepatide produced 23.3% weight loss at 48 weeks, versus 14.8% for tirzepatide alone, but more patients dropped out. Phase 3 trials are planned.

headline: Survodutide Hits Both Goals in Obesity Plus Type 2 Diabetes Trial
summary: In the 76-week SYNCHRONIZE-2 trial, which reported at EASD 2026, survodutide produced up to 13.1% weight loss versus 3.1% on placebo and lowered HbA1c by up to 1.21%.

headline: FDA Warning Letters Target 'Research Use Only' Peptide Sellers
summary: In August the FDA warned five online sellers that research-use labels don't shield products marketed with dosing guides. State boards are tightening rules as well.

headline: UK Becomes First in Europe to Authorise Orforglipron Pill
summary: The MHRA cleared Lilly's once-daily GLP-1 tablet Foundayo for weight management and type 2 diabetes. It has no food or water timing rules, and NHS access awaits NICE review.

headline: Oral Semaglutide Reduces Heavy Drinking Days in Phase 2 Trial
summary: In 50 adults with alcohol use disorder, eight weeks of oral semaglutide cut heavy drinking days but did not reduce lab-measured craving. Larger trials are planned.

headline: Retatrutide Succeeds in TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3
summary: Weight loss reached 20.8% in type 2 diabetes and 22.6% in people with severe obesity and heart disease. Lilly plans to file with the FDA in Q1 2027.

headline: FDA Advisers Back BPC-157, TB-500 and Four More Peptides for Compounding
summary: Going against FDA staff, the compounding advisory panel recommended six of seven peptides for the 503A bulks list, with BPC-157 passing 8–6. The vote is non-binding.

headline: Semaglutide Slowed Epigenetic Aging Clocks in Randomized Trial
summary: A Nature Communications analysis of a 32-week HIV trial found semaglutide slowed DunedinPACE aging by 9% compared with placebo. The authors caution that it does not reverse aging.

headline: Quintuple Agonist for Obesity: One Drug, 5 Receptors
summary: Eli Lilly–funded scientist set to present rodent data at the ADA meeting on a five-pathway compound that has already edged out retatrutide in rat weight loss.

headline: Cancer Research Peptides 2026 Update — What's Changed
summary: Three oncology peptide classes driving 2026 — checkpoint mimetics, ADC linkers, dual GLP-1/GIP agonists. Engineering tricks pushed half-life from 2 to 8-14 hours.

headline: The 2026 Peptide Outlook: Five Next-Generation Therapeutics Reshaping Longevity
summary: Profiles five next-gen peptide candidates targeting molecular hallmarks of aging itself rather than age-related diseases, with receptor-level mechanism breakdowns.

headline: Peptide Clinical Trials 2026: Research Pipeline Update
summary: 150+ peptide drugs in active clinical development. TRIUMPH-1 retatrutide Phase 3 readouts expected H2 2026 and survodutide MASH results late 2026.

headline: Top Peptide Research Trends Shaping Health in 2026
summary: Three fronts: delivery engineering, AI-driven design, precision characterization. Oral semaglutide and Luna18's 21-47% preclinical bioavailability resetting the threshold.
